..Title
Resolution to Approve Change Order No. 1 with Z Contractors, Inc. for the Huron Parkway Bridge Capital Preventative Maintenance Project ($86,059.75 Increase, Total Contract Amount $743,506.26)
..Memorandum
Attached for your review and approval is a change order to the construction contract with Z Contractors, Inc. (RFP 22-09) for the Huron Parkway Bridge Capital Preventative Maintenance Project.

This project consists of performing capital preventative maintenance repairs on the Huron Parkway Bridge over the Huron River.  Capital Preventative Maintenance repairs are work that is considered beyond the normal operations and maintenance work that would be performed by the City's own Public Works forces. More specifically, the work includes the repair of spalled concrete and delaminated concrete areas on deck, curbs and sidewalks; and portions of the guardrails, as well as removal of trees and vegetation growth in the rip-rap areas along three northern piers and other minor items. The bridge was originally constructed in 1968 and partially rehabilitated in 2000 and 2007.  

The additional contract work includes some minor additions such as anti-slip coating on all 8 of the expansion joint covers rather than just 4 and adding some missing items of work. The total change order amount is $86,059.75, which exceeds the contingency originally approved by Council ($66,000.00). This Change Order will bring the total contract amount to $743,506.26 and will allow for final payment to the contractor and subsequent closing out of the contract. 
  
Budget/Fiscal Impact: Funding for the project and this change order is included in the FY23-28 Capital Improvements Plan (TR-BR-18-02). Funding is available in the approved Public Services Area, Street, Bridge and Sidewalk Millage Capital Budget.
..Staff
Prepared by:         Nicholas Hutchinson, P.E., City Engineer
Reviewed by:        Brian Steglitz, Interim Public Services Area Administrator
Approved by:        Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, The City of Ann Arbor has a Bridge Asset Management Plan that provides guidance for performing repairs to the City's bridge network in order to keep them in a state of good repair;  

Whereas, The Huron Parkway Bridge over the Huron River needs repairs to maintain the structure in a state of good repair;

Whereas, Funding for this change order is available in the approved Public Services Area, Street, Bridge and Sidewalk Millage Capital Budget;

Whereas, The existing approved contingency amount of $66,000.00 is insufficient to cover the additional work in Change Order No. 1; and 

Whereas, Z Contractors, Inc has submitted all required Non-Discrimination, Prevailing Wage, Living Wage, and Conflict of Interest Disclosure forms and complies with the requirements of the City's Non-Discrimination, Prevailing Wage and Living Wage ordinances;

RESOLVED, That City Council approve Change Order No. 1 to the construction contract with Z Contractors, Inc. in the amount of $86,059.75 for a total contract amount of $743,506.26 for additional work on the Huron Parkway Bridge Capital Preventative Maintenance Repairs Project (RFP 22-09); and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take the necessary administrative actions to implement this resolution.
